1 - pct_owner_occupied: the renter-occupied share of occupied housing units (fraction 0-1). Note pct_owner_occupied is a share of *occupied* units while pct_vacant is a share of *all* units, so this field excludes vacant stock and renter + vacant does not always sum to 1. Blank where the source owner share is missing (those VTDs also have blank or zero housing_units).
